batch: Phase F1 -- first scan of the untagged noun pool (4,215 common nouns never classified at all), top 60 by frequency reviewed
scope_note: This is a genuinely new pool, distinct from T2's own noun review (Phases C1-C4) -- these strongs have NO cluster row of any kind, not even T2. High-risk dual-referent terms (father/son/God's-name-adjacent words) are deliberately deferred, not forced, matching the H0113 'lord' precedent.
